If you care about 1) property rights, 2) public lands, or 3) government waste, what’s happening in Big Bend right now should have your attention. POTUS and DHS have awarded billions in border wall contracts to Trump campaign donors. They’re in a national park, where all environmental laws have been waived, constructing useless roads next to existing roads and preparing to dynamite the mountain range that gives “Big Bend” National Park its name… for a patrol road and vehicle barriers.
